listed_quote.quote: Minnesota Municipal Income Portfolio Inc. (NYSE: MXA) and First American Minnesota Municipal Income Fund II, Inc. (NYSE: MXN) have merged into a newly organized closed-end fund, now known as the Nuveen Minnesota Municipal Income Fund (NYSE: NMS)

announcement.quote: proposals to merge the Funds into a newly organized closed-end fund which would be managed by Nuveen Fund Advisors, LLC and sub-advised by Nuveen Asset Management, LLC

deals.notes: Special meetings were adjourned on 2014-08-15 to 2014-09-15 for lack of votes; the 2014-10-06 press release (EX-99.1 of the 8-K) reports the merger done. Earlier N-14 and 425 excerpts do not state the merger in words, so the announcement quote is from the 2014-08-15 press release.
